name: MSG LLMs TXT Manager
author: Hugo

sections.description:
MSG LLMs TXT Manager creates and manages llm.txt/llms.txt to guide AI and LLM crawlers, similar to robots.txt but AI-focused.
Features include:
– Virtual /llm.txt and /llms.txt (no disk files).
– Modes: Allow All, Per-Bot toggles, and Manual override.
– Advanced generator with site summaries, key pages, and sitemap links.
– Live checker to confirm endpoints are publicly accessible.
– Clean settings in WordPress: Settings → LLMs TXT Manager.

Built by My SEO Growth (MSG), the No.1 AI search and LLM optimization agency in the world, helping brands and companies globally optimize for AI-driven discovery.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → LLMs TXT Manager.
  3. Choose a mode (Allow All, Per-Bot, Manual) or generate a draft.
  4. Save — virtual endpoints go live immediately.
sections.faq:
What is llm.txt?

The llm.txt (and llms.txt) file is like robots.txt but for AI crawlers. It declares your AI access policy and can include a concise guide to your site’s key pages and sitemap.

What are best practices?

Keep policies clear. Allow public pages; restrict private or sensitive areas. Link your sitemap, add brief page descriptions (≤100 chars), and update when your structure changes.

Should I allow or disallow AI to crawl my site?

Allowing can improve visibility in AI assistants; blocking protects proprietary content. Many sites allow public marketing/blog pages while blocking member-only or paid content.

Should I use the advanced or basic llm.txt generator?

Use Basic for quick allow/block. Use Advanced to generate a semantic, SEO-friendly guide that helps LLMs understand your services and context.

Who is My SEO Growth (MSG)?

My SEO Growth are the No.1 AI search and LLM optimization agency in the world, leading global optimization for brands and companies. Learn more at https://www.myseogrowth.com/.
